GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 3 lengths. 3rd turn getting up fence 2 lengths. battled away # Every Chance

Jumped fairly. Pushed fwd before raced Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead) early . Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along 3 Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 300m & bumped out Six Wide @ 200m. Ran on soundly in last 100m but no match. # Had her chance.

Jumped okay & Went Forward to 3 Wide joint Lead settling down, Headed soon after and moved in Two Wide , 2nd trailing 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated she was instructed to settle prominently with cover. She added, after beginning well, and when runners to her inside showed sufficient early speed, she was left without cover and felt it may not have appreciated this.] # wide/worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance, rider stated that she was instructed to find a prominent position with cover as the mare has a tendency to overrace. She added that after beginning well and when runners to her inside showed sufficient early speed, she was left without cover, which she felt the mare may not have appreciated.
